item.title: Software 2.0
item.dc:creator: Andrej Karpathy
item.content:encoded:
I sometimes see people refer to neural networks as just “another tool in your machine learning toolbox”. This fixture keeps the first lines of the shape and nothing more.

The classical stack

The “classical stack” of Software 1.0 is what we’re all familiar with: it is written in languages such as Python and C++.

Software 2.0 was originally published in Medium, where people are continuing the conversation by highlighting and responding to this story.
